arch: SPM packages by feature - app target stays thin

actors for shared mutable state - no locks by hand

idioms: guard let for early exits, map flatMap over force unwrap

retain cycles in closures - weak or unowned self
UI updates off main actor - annotate MainActor
style: let over var, access control explicit
no force unwrap or try-bang outside tests

triggers: setting up SPM packages or XCTest
